title: The Copper Atlas
author: Lior Eriksen
blurb: Lena Blackwood, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
